_comment1: Example Genie server config - copy to genie_server_config.json and edit. JSON has no comments, so every '_comment*' key is documentation only and ignored by the loader.
_comment2: characters are loaded in order at startup. Put the default voice first. 'feibi' is the official v2ProPlus character downloaded from HuggingFace High-Logic/Genie (CharacterModels/v2ProPlus/feibi); it has no static decode graph, so with static_decode=true it runs the dynamic graph while static-capable characters use the CUDA-graph path.
_comment3: dq is an EXAMPLE entry for a privately converted voice (GPT-SoVITS checkpoint -> ONNX). Point onnx_model_dir/ref_audio at your own files; the repo ships no voice data.
_comment4: dll_dirs/torch_site are optional Windows CUDA helpers - only needed if torch is not importable from the server's Python environment.

feibi.ref_text: 在此之前，请您务必继续享受旅居拉古那的时光。
